none: PAS FindID 1012580: Roman coin: radiate, possibly of Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate, possibly of Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate head right, short beard. Obverse inscription: [IMP] C C[L]AVD[IVS AVG]. Reverse description: Figure standing left with vertical spear. Reverse inscription: possibly [MARS]VL[TOR]. Diameter: 17.8mm, Weight: 2.00gms, die axis: 12
